<!-- chill-sol-theme -->
<style id="chill-sol-theme">
/* CHILL Sol/GTA meme theme — keeps c09 layout, restyles skin to match chillonsol.fun */
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Russo+One&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap");

html[data-theme-mode="preset"],
html[data-theme-mode="custom"],
html {
  --lime:#97F202;
  --lime-d:#5E9A0C;
  --lime-ink:#0B2A02;
  --sky1:#C01D68;
  --sky2:#EC2F58;
  --sky3:#FC6639;
  --sky4:#FD9222;
  --sun:#FCEC60;
  --amber:#FFC53D;
  --teal:#19C3D9;
  --violet:#5B2A86;
  --ink:#140A16;
  --plum:#3A0F2A;
  --asphalt:#2B223A;
  --panel:#4A2553;
  --panel2:#5A3063;
  --cream:#FFF3E3;
  --muted:#D9C6D7;
  --hard:6px 6px 0 var(--ink);
  --hard-s:4px 4px 0 var(--ink);
  --disp:"Russo One",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --body:"Inter",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --theme-1:#97F202;
  --theme-2:#FC6639;
  --theme-ink:#140A16;
  --theme-glow:rgba(151,242,2,.28);
  --theme-grad:linear-gradient(90deg,#97F202,#FCEC60 50%,#FC6639);
  --gold:#FD9222;
  --gold-bright:#FCEC60;
  --gold-deep:#EC2F58;
  --acc:#97F202;
  --acc2:#FD9222;
  --btnfg:#140A16;
  --bg:#2A1631;
  --fg:#FFF3E3;
  --mut:#D9C6D7;
  --card:#4A2553;
  --line:#140A16;
  --fd:"Russo One",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --fb:"Inter",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --fm:"Inter",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --fbtn:"Inter",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --black:#140A16;
  --coal:#331B3B;
  --hairline:#140A16;
  --hairline-soft:rgba(20,10,22,.4);
}

html, body.a-c09-manifesting {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--fg);
  font-family: var(--body);
}

/* Type: Russo One display, Inter body — not Cinzel/Cormorant */
body.a-c09-manifesting .wordmark,
body.a-c09-manifesting .wordmark.gold-grad,
body.a-c09-manifesting h1,
body.a-c09-manifesting h2,
body.a-c09-manifesting h3,
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-h2,
body.a-c09-manifesting .sec-title,
body.a-c09-manifesting .join h2,
body.a-c09-manifesting .about h2,
body.a-c09-manifesting .tok-cell .v,
body.a-c09-manifesting .fb,
body.a-c09-manifesting .nav .brand {
  font-family: var(--disp) !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
  text-indent: 0 !important;
  text-transform: none;
}

body.a-c09-manifesting,
body.a-c09-manifesting p,
body.a-c09-manifesting .about p,
body.a-c09-manifesting .join .sub,
body.a-c09-manifesting .eyebrow,
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-kick,
body.a-c09-manifesting .channels-rule,
body.a-c09-manifesting .hero-tagline,
body.a-c09-manifesting .btn-gold,
body.a-c09-manifesting .btn,
body.a-c09-manifesting .tok-cell .k,
body.a-c09-manifesting .step,
body.a-c09-manifesting footer,
body.a-c09-manifesting .mbar {
  font-family: var(--body) !important;
}

/* Wordmark: GTA lime, hard ink shadow (no gold serif) */
body.a-c09-manifesting .wordmark,
body.a-c09-manifesting .wordmark.gold-grad {
  background: none !important;
  -webkit-background-clip: unset !important;
  background-clip: unset !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #97F202 !important;
  color: #97F202 !important;
  animation: none !important;
  text-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #140A16, -1px 0 0 #140A16, 1px 0 0 #140A16;
  font-weight: 400;
}

body.a-c09-manifesting .gold-grad:not(.wordmark) {
  background: none !important;
  -webkit-background-clip: unset !important;
  background-clip: unset !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #FFF3E3 !important;
  color: #FFF3E3 !important;
}

body.a-c09-manifesting .hero-tagline {
  color: #FFF3E3;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .14em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

body.a-c09-manifesting .nav .brand {
  color: #97F202 !important;
  text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #140A16;
  font-size: 22px;
}

body.a-c09-manifesting .nav {
  background: #140A16;
  border-bottom: 3px solid #97F202;
}

body.a-c09-manifesting .eyebrow,
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-kick,
body.a-c09-manifesting .channels-rule {
  color: #97F202 !important;
  letter-spacing: .18em !important;
  font-weight: 800;
}

/* Lime hard-shadow buttons (chillonsol meme CTA) */
body.a-c09-manifesting .btn-gold,
body.a-c09-manifesting .btn-gold.solid,
body.a-c09-manifesting a.btn-gold,
body.a-c09-manifesting .btn.btn-main,
body.a-c09-manifesting .mbar .btn-main,
body.a-c09-manifesting .copy-btn,
html[data-theme-mode="preset"] body.a-c09-manifesting .btn-gold,
html[data-theme-mode="preset"] body.a-c09-manifesting .btn.btn-main,
html[data-theme-mode="preset"] body.a-c09-manifesting a.btn[data-buy] {
  background: #97F202 !important;
  color: #140A16 !important;
  border: 3px solid #140A16 !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #140A16 !important;
  letter-spacing: .08em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .btn-gold:hover,
body.a-c09-manifesting a.btn-gold:hover,
body.a-c09-manifesting .btn.btn-main:hover,
body.a-c09-manifesting .copy-btn:hover,
html[data-theme-mode="preset"] body.a-c09-manifesting .btn-gold:hover {
  background: #FCEC60 !important;
  color: #140A16 !important;
  border-color: #140A16 !important;
  letter-spacing: .08em !important;
  transform: translate(-2px,-2px);
  box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #140A16 !important;
}

/* Sticker / receipt frames for characters and gallery — not the logo */
body.a-c09-manifesting .mani-figure img.gchar {
  filter: drop-shadow(5px 6px 0 #140A16);
  background: transparent;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .about-card {
  border: 3px solid #140A16 !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #140A16 !important;
  background: #4A2553 !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .about-card::after {
  box-shadow: none !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 60%, rgba(20,10,22,.35));
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .about-card .halo {
  border: 3px solid #FCEC60 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 28px #FD9222, inset 0 0 18px rgba(252,236,96,.35) !important;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .about-card img.gchar {
  object-fit: contain !important;
  object-position: center 40% !important;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #C01D68 0 20%, #EC2F58 20% 40%, #FC6639 40% 60%, #FD9222 60% 80%, #FCEC60 80%);
}

body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-card {
  border: 3px solid #140A16 !important;
  border-radius: 14px 14px 16px 16px !important;
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #140A16 !important;
  background: #FFF3E3 !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-card:nth-child(odd) { transform: rotate(-1.5deg) !important; }
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-card:nth-child(even) { transform: rotate(1.4deg) !important; }
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-card:hover {
  transform: translate(-2px,-2px) rotate(0) scale(1.02) !important;
  box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #140A16 !important;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-card img.gimg {
  background: #2A1631;
  object-fit: cover;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-card span {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--body) !important;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #140A16;
  background: #FFC53D;
  padding: 9px 10px 10px;
  border-top: 3px solid #140A16;
}

/* Panels, tokenomics, channels, steps — thick ink + hard shadow */
body.a-c09-manifesting .tok-cell,
body.a-c09-manifesting .channel-grid a,
body.a-c09-manifesting .tok-ca,
body.a-c09-manifesting .ca-box {
  border: 3px solid #140A16 !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #140A16;
  background: #4A2553 !important;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .channel-grid a:hover {
  background: #5A3063 !important;
  border-color: #140A16 !important;
  transform: translate(-2px,-2px);
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #140A16;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .tok-cell .v { color: #97F202 !important; }
body.a-c09-manifesting .step {
  border-top: 3px solid #140A16 !important;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .step .num,
body.a-c09-manifesting .step .n,
html[data-theme-mode="preset"] body.a-c09-manifesting .step .n {
  color: #97F202 !important;
  border-color: #97F202 !important;
  font-family: var(--disp) !important;
}

body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-sec,
body.a-c09-manifesting footer,
body.a-c09-manifesting .tokenomics-sec,
body.a-c09-manifesting .buy,
body.a-c09-manifesting .channels {
  background: #2A1631;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-memes { border-top: 3px solid #140A16; }
body.a-c09-manifesting footer {
  border-top: 3px solid #97F202;
  background: #140A16;
}

body.a-c09-manifesting .about p,
body.a-c09-manifesting .join .sub {
  color: #D9C6D7 !important;
  font-style: normal !important;
}

/* Keep the real logo (footer, favicon, chart overlay) unstyled / unfiltered */
body.a-c09-manifesting footer img,
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-chart .ov img,
body.a-c09-manifesting img[src*="assets/logo."] {
  filter: none !important;
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* Hero background should read clearly (GTA keyart) */
body.a-c09-manifesting .hero .bg { opacity: 1; }
body.a-c09-manifesting .about .slot { opacity: .28; }
body.a-c09-manifesting .join .slot { opacity: .6; }

/* Dial back ethereum-preset indigo glows so sunset/keyart can show */
html[data-theme-mode="preset"] body.a-c09-manifesting .hero {
  box-shadow: inset 0 -40px 80px rgba(20,10,22,.35);
}

/* GTA video loops */
body.a-c09-manifesting .hero .bg {
  animation: none !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .hero .bg .hero-vid {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center 38%;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: transparent;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .hero .bg::after {
  z-index: 1;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20,10,22,0.72) 0%, rgba(20,10,22,0.12) 28%, rgba(20,10,22,0.08) 55%, rgba(20,10,22,0.82) 100%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at center 42%, rgba(20,10,22,0) 40%, rgba(20,10,22,0.4) 100%);
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .hero-stage,
body.a-c09-manifesting .hero-scroll { position: relative; z-index: 2; }

body.a-c09-manifesting .join-vid {
  margin: 0 auto 28px;
  max-width: min(720px, 100%);
  border: 3px solid #140A16;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #140A16;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #140A16;
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .join-vid video {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  vertical-align: top;
}

body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-vidcard {
  position: relative;
  border: 3px solid #140A16;
  border-radius: 14px 14px 16px 16px;
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #140A16;
  background: #FFF3E3;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  transform: rotate(1.2deg);
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-vidcard video {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  background: #2A1631;
}
body.a-c09-manifesting .ck-vidcard span {
  display: block;
  font-family: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #140A16;
  background: #FFC53D;
  padding: 9px 10px 10px;
  border-top: 3px solid #140A16;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  body.a-c09-manifesting .hero .bg .hero-vid { display: none; }
}

</style>
<script id="chill-vid-motion">(function(){try{if(window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){document.querySelectorAll('video[autoplay]').forEach(function(v){v.removeAttribute('autoplay');v.pause();v.currentTime=0;});}}catch(e){}})();</script>
